description.value: The study developed and validated a visual MRI rating method for frontal and temporal brain regions using manual volumetry and voxel-based morphometry, and compared regional atrophy across controls, Alzheimer's disease, semantic dementia and behavioural variant frontotemporal dementia.

spans.text: We aimed to devise a rating method for key frontal and temporal brain regions validated against quantitative volumetric methods and applicable to a range of dementia syndromes.

description.value: A cross-sectional evaluation of MRI scans from controls and dementia cases, using visual ratings, manual volumetry and voxel-based morphometry.

value: Significant differences (p<0.05 corrected) between rating categories were found for 12 of the 15 regions. In ten of these 12 regions, the predicted direction of differences was confirmed in all analyses, with lower-rated groups showing higher grey matter concentrations. For anterior basal ganglia and anterior cingulate cortex, comparison between normal (rated 0) and abnormal (rated 1, 2, 3 or 4) showed a significant difference in the predicted direction. For posterior hippocampus, superior temporal and posterior temporal regions, significant clusters were found in the vicinity of the predefined coordinates. Complementary analyses of CSF concentration showed that ventricular size increased with severity of hippocampal rating.
